label: Bangla in Bangladesh
script_or_mode: Bengali script
population_definition: Arithmetic scale proxy from the BBS 2022 adjusted population and the SEDS 2023 weighted sample share 99.17% for Bangla as childhood language of greatest speaking proficiency. It is retained only as approximately 168.42m context, not an exact count or uncertainty interval.
population_secondary_context: 169828911 x 99.17% = 168419331 for reproducibility. The former 168410840-168427822 endpoints reflected decimal rounding only and are removed because they omitted sample/design, nonresponse, measurement and cross-year uncertainty.
education_language_exposure_mismatch_by_: Bangla is the dominant school language. LASI Table 28 reports Band 2 or below on a common English scale: Grade 6 general 27% (SE 1.5), madrasah 37% (SE 4.1); Grade 8 general 9% (SE 0.7), madrasah 12% (SE 1.7). No home-language split.
learning_completion_evidence: Final MICS 2025: ages 7-14 foundational reading 50.2% and numeracy 39.2%; completion primary 83.7%, lower secondary 69.3%, upper secondary 43.9%. Among children of expected age for Grades 2/3, 24.4% met reading and 18.2% numeracy standards. Reading tasks could be Bangla or English; results are national.
functional_resource_access: NCTB pages establish downloadable books at the specifically listed grades/stages only. They do not establish full-stage completeness, accessibility or open reuse/adaptation rights.
open_adaptable_scarcity: Functional school supply is strong; title-level open reuse/adaptation and a complete openly licensed higher-education/research ladder remain unverified.
academic_lingua_franca_nonoverlap: Partial school cohorts only. LASI measures English thresholds but has no home-language split; adult and tertiary academic-English overlap are unknown.
device_connectivity_electricity: MICS 2025 national context: home internet 72.1%; women 15-49 recent internet use 48.3%; women 15-24 ICT skill 37.6%. No exact Bangla cross-tab.
accessible_offline_delivery_evidence: Downloadable/printable NCTB content, low-data audio, local-server/SD distribution, semantic reflow, captions and screen-reader support fit the access evidence. Gender and skills gaps prohibit internet-only assumptions.
source_locators: BBS PHC 2022 National Report Vol. I Table 3.2.1 p49; SEDS 2023 pp65-66/Table 3.6; final MICS 2025 findings; LASI Table 28 p47; bounded NCTB stage pages.
uncertainty_incompatibilities: The point is a mixed-year derived proxy from a census adjustment and a weighted household sample share. It is unrankable against direct counts; national learning and English-stage measures lack a Bangla-only cross-tab.
evidence_confidence: medium for approximate language scale; high for cited national MICS/LASI endpoints; low for exact population and open-resource completeness

functional_resource_access: No resource negative control is imported from Mainland zh-Hans. Territory-specific functional inventories remain unmeasured in this bundle.
open_adaptable_scarcity: Unknown; zh-Hans availability or catalogs never control zh-Hant adaptation, accessibility or stage completeness.
academic_lingua_franca_nonoverlap: Unknown; territorial residence does not measure academic written-Chinese or English proficiency.
device_connectivity_electricity: No territorial connectivity rate is transformed into a zh-Hant person count in this row.
accessible_offline_delivery_evidence: Traditional-character typography, vertical-text behavior, semantic reflow, captions/audio and downloadable/print options require territory-specific QA; no population product is derived.
source_locators: Macao DSEC detailed 2021 Population Census results, total and local-population definitions.
uncertainty_incompatibilities: Territorial ceiling only; not traditional-character literacy or any spoken-language count. Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao are kept disjoint and are not added to Mainland or Putonghua rows.
evidence_confidence: high for official territorial count; low for exact zh-Hant readers, learning, connectivity and resource completeness
